description: Derived from AGSC-01-27: `export --jsonl` emits one JCS-canonical JSON object per LF-terminated line, one line per item, items in slug order, each line being exactly the per-item JSON-LD node of pages/<slug>.jsonld of the same build. The minimal fixture is given the three concepts of `export-0001`: edited, undated and draft-note, the last a draft that no published surface carries (AGSC-06-30). `lines_from_pages` names, in order, the slug whose pages/<slug>.jsonld each line equals with its one trailing LF removed; the file is those lines, each followed by one LF, and nothing else. The bytes of the nodes are those the build writes, so no byte is restated here. The export exits 0.
